about: THE FIGHT ANSWER FOR EVERY BUILDING KIND ON THE MAP (WORLD THIRTEEN, VAMILY rule 429(b), ask line 505; Paolo 11/7: 'maybe the combat map is just the whole map itself... for every building that we have on the regular map we need to answer for that in the combat map'). ONE MAP: the fight is cut from the map where it starts, so every kind the map draws says here what a fight tile of it is. A modder's file: add a kind to the map and it needs a row here or gates/the_map_kinds_have_fight_answers_gate.js goes red. Words are draft:true. NO FELT NUMBER LIVES HERE: what a storey does (the defence, the range, the hit chance) is records/target/bb/ours.json roof_storeys, height_is_accuracy and cover_defence (TUNING's and COMBAT TWO's); this file only says which kind is which. The storeys mixes are a reading of the real Las Vegas building stock (a reading, not a census: tract houses mostly one or two storeys, three rare), his to correct.
quote: 'every house should be a tile that I can be on... if it's one story I can still be on top of it, that's a defense boost, but not a range offense boost... there's no ladder system' (11/7); 'more defence, more range offense bonus depending on whether it's a one or two-story house... three-story houses are rare, but not unheard of' (11/7); 'if there's a house there's a street in front' (11/7)

fields.class: the painter's family for the kind (vbClassOf in slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html); the gate holds the two together
fields.building: what a built tile of the kind is: house, trailer, slab, shop, works, civic, tower, casino, hall, compound, tank, silo, shed, barn, clubhouse, stands, hangar, stall, car, deck, town; none = no building, open ground
fields.storeys: how high a man on its roof stands, as a mix that sums to 1: {"1": share, "2": share, "3": share}; empty for open ground. The fight reads its level from storeysOf(kind, roll) in engine/bohemia_fight_kinds.js so the map and the fight agree on the same roll
fields.man: in_or_roof: a man goes in it (its walls his cover) or on its roof (its storeys his height), no ladder; in: in at the street only; roof: on top only (a container, a tank, a boxcar, a deck); open: no building, the ground is walked; none: nobody stands there (open water)
fields.cover: what the building gives the man in it or on it: full, half, none
fields.open_cover: what the kind's open ground carries for a man (dead cars, block walls, rocks, stalls): full, half, none
fields.blocks: what stops a step or a shot: walls (a step and a shot, a man inside shoots out of its windows), fence (a step, never a shot), water (a step), cliff (a step and a shot), rows (a step across the rows, never a shot), barrier (a step, half cover), rail (rough ground, a step slower)
fields.street_front: true: every building of the kind fronts a street (426(a)); false: the one exception, the trailer park's lanes; absent for open ground
fields.place: the place board (ours.json place_boards) the kind fights on today; the 15 layouts are written into the map at their places (rule 429(c))
fields.picture: a debt on the picture: what the map draws there today when it is not yet what this row says
fields.zone: the land-use zone the kind belongs to (records/target/bb/land_use.json, rule 429(g)): the fight knows if it is in the works, a tract, the Strip or the open desert

storeys_do.1: a slight defence bonus, NO range bonus (428(b))
storeys_do.2: more defence AND a range bonus (428(b))
storeys_do.numbers: ours.json roof_storeys (the level), height_is_accuracy (per storey), cover_defence (per piece): never typed here
storeys_do.ladders: none: a man steps onto a roof from the next tile as Battle Brothers climbs a hill, no ladder piece (423(d))

places.about: THE PLACES' OWN ROWS (WORLD 14 11/8, VAMILY rule 436(b), ask line 521): the missing real places of records/target/bb/real_places.json that have a visit, each with its fight answer in this table's own fields; 'kind' is the map kind it stands on (its district row above must agree on class, building and storeys), 'where' valley or region. The lab is on the region's land, not a valley kind: this row is its only answer. Written by tools/bohemia_world14_place_fight_answers.py; gates/the_places_get_their_use_gate.js holds it. Words draft:true.

the_lab.is: the lab on the fossil beds: one long block of labs and the freezer house, the pens in a row behind chain-link, the bone beds round it; a man goes in the labs (block walls, his cover) or up on the flat roofs (one storey mostly, the freezer house two); the pens' chain-link stops a step, never a shot
the_lab.picture: the region paints it as any fortress (its trade reads 'hilltown': houses behind a wall); a compound of labs and pens is owed, COOK FOUR's golden piece (rule 408)

the_bank.is: the bank tower over its banking hall; under it the vault, the strongest room in town: one door, no window, a man inside has full cover and no shot out; the boxes room beside it; the paper in the cages stops nothing

the_unemployment_office.is: one low office block and the line round it: the men in the line are people, never cover; the queue rails and the parked cars along the line are the open ground's half cover

the_home_center_east.is: the big box: one tall shed (a two-storey roof), the garden centre's fenced yard, the lumber canopy, pallets in the lot for half cover

the_home_center_west.is: the west side's big box, the same as the east's: the tall shed, the garden yard, the receiving dock at the back

clark_station.is: the gas plant at Whitney: the turbine hall and the 1954 boiler house (tall, two and three storeys), the stacks, the switchyard behind its fence; the charging racks inside the hall; whoever is in the hall has full cover and the windows

lenzie_station.is: the big gas plant at Apex: three turbine halls in a row, the stacks with their red lights, the switchyard's fence and breakers in the open; a man goes in a hall or up on its roof (two storeys, the stack decks three); the switchyard is half cover
lenzie_station.picture: the region paints it as works (its land kind, industrial); the three halls and the stacks are COOK FOUR's golden piece

shark_reef.is: the resort over it and the aquarium under it: the tunnel under the big tank (a step through, glass both sides), the touch pool, the tank's open water stops a step; the casino floor above is the fight's ground

the_animal_shelter.is: one storey of office and kennel runs behind chain-link: the runs stop a step, never a shot; the dogs that never left are in them

the_mob_museum.is: the 1933 federal courthouse: three storeys of stone (the hearing room on the third), deep windows, the steps in front; the family's men inside have full cover and a shot down the street

the_natural_history_museum.is: the museum's low halls by Cashman Field, the T. rex in the big hall under a high roof, the cases as half cover inside

the_tv_station.is: Channel 8's low studios under the mast; the mast's fenced base and the satellite dishes in the lot (half cover)

spring_mountain_ranch.is: the old ranch under the Red Rock cliffs: the ranch house (two storeys of block and wood), the long barn with its loft, the corrals and the hay; corral rails stop a step, never a shot; the hay bales half cover
spring_mountain_ranch.picture: the region paints it with its garden look (fields and a farmhouse); the ranch house, the barn and the corrals are COOK FOUR's golden piece

callville_bay.is: the campground and RV park on the lake shore: motorhomes in rows on the campground's loop road (a man in one or on its roof, its thin walls half cover), the marina's dock on the mud, the lake's water stopping a step
callville_bay.picture: the region paints it with its trailer look; the motorhomes on their loops and the dry marina are COOK FOUR's golden piece
